messages.author: cc62cdc7c1746f0f
messages.subject: ld map error
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to run the gl.report.ld to run my ld filter, but I am having the error below. Can somebody please help me? 

> ldmap <- gl.report.ld.map(gl3)
Starting gl.report.ld.map
  Processing genlight object with SNP data
  Calculating pairwise LD in population COL
Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)) :
  error in evaluating the argument 'j' in selecting a method for function '[': argument 1 is not a vector

Thank you,
Laia

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: ld map error
parts:
Hi Laia,

As mentioned in the function documentation:
If SNPs are not mapped to a reference genome, the parameter ld.max.pairwise should be set as NULL (the default). In this case, the function will assign the same chromosome ("1") to all the SNPs in the dataset and assign a sequence from 1 to n loci as the position of each SNP. The function will then calculate LD for all possible SNP pair combinations.

library(dartR.base)
gl3 <- readRDS("test.rds")
ldmap <- gl.report.ld.map(gl3, ind.limit = 3,ld.max.pairwise=NULL)

Cheers,
Luis
